=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the adult man in a Facebook photograph posted 22 June 2017. The Facebook photo viewer names Len Luczkowski. Bill confirmed the dest. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group since 11 September 2016 (added by Nick Enrique; facebook.com/len.luczkowski). Red 107 State College, PA on the Decipher listing; the fan table prints Bensalem, PA. A 25 June 2017 group post sold his SWCCG collection and a Decipher Red Squadron TD bag; he hosted tournaments at Penn State. Photo-viewer arrows load more photographs; a Star Wars still (Slave Leia, 27 December 2016) is a strong dest factor. Do not dest that still, the three children, the cat, or Meghann as the lead. The circular is the black cat. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Len Luczkowski portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Len Luczkowski Facebook portrait.jpg]].
